Lists and services the app asks

  • MalwareBazaar by abuse.ch (bazaar.abuse.ch) - the list of known malware fingerprints.
  • CIRCL hashlookup (hashlookup.circl.lu), Computer Incident Response Center Luxembourg - asked about a file's fingerprint only, never the file.
  • Phishing.Database by Mitchell Krog and contributors - github.com/Phishing-Database/Phishing.Database, MIT licence.
  • Warning List by CERT Polska (NASK-PIB) - hole.cert.pl, a list of phishing sites; its data policy lets anyone use it for any purpose. CERT Polska does not endorse or work with Virus Vigil.
  • chrome-mal-ids by The Privacy Commons Institute - known harmful browser extensions, CC BY 4.0.
  • Pwned Passwords by Have I Been Pwned (haveibeenpwned.com) - only the first 5 characters of a password's hash leave the device.
  • Groq (groq.com) - the optional online helper, only when you choose to send a question.

These organisations provide their data free and "as is", and are not connected with Virus Vigil. They do not endorse it.
